name: Accordion
summary: A stack of headed sections that open and close in place: frequently asked questions, a long form's optional parts, settings grouped by topic. Not for one short "Help with…" passage (use a disclosure), for switching between views of one thing (use Tabs) or for content everyone must read (show it).
a11y: APG accordion: each heading holds a button with `aria-expanded` and `aria-controls`; each open section is a region named by its heading. A closed section's content is `hidden`, so it is out of the tab order and the accessibility tree. A summary line is part of the button, so it is read with the heading. "Show all sections" says what it will do. The chevron turns with a transform; with reduced motion it turns at once.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: The sections open at first, by `id`.

props.name: single
props.description: One section open at a time: opening one closes the other (a short FAQ). Default: any number open.

props.name: showAll
props.description: Adds "Show all sections" and "Hide all sections" above the list (any number open only), for long pages people scan.

props.name: headingLevel
props.description: The headings' level in the page's outline.

props.name: title
props.description: The section's heading: a question or a short name.

props.name: summary
props.description: A line under the heading, read with it: a summary of what's inside.
